messages:
support_li: seeing a sudden spike of 502/504s on hosted /v1/generate from multiple customers in eu-west1. start ~08:13 UTC. logs show upstream timeouts to kv-service.

support_li: sample request id: req_0a7f3b, gateway reports `cache lookup timeout` then `upstream 504`. lots of distinct user keys.

oncall-bot: @sre_jamie oncall triggered (pager duty).

sre_jamie: looking. any recent deploys to kv or gateway?

morgan: no infra deploys in last 30m. Cloud metrics show redis-client connection resets on r-eu-west1-3 node starting 08:12.

support_li: customers reporting degraded latency and refresh loops in their apps. one report shows 10x latency and errors SLO breach.

alex: pulled `kv-service` logs — getting repetitive `ERR connection reset by peer` and `io timeout` when dialing r-eu-west1-3. memcached fallback pool also showing high error rates.

sre_jamie: can we isolate region? route policy currently set to prefer eu-west1 for EU customers; fallback to us-central is allowed but circuit is closed.

infra_ops: temporarily opened gateway routing to allow cross-region fallback (policy: prefer->allow) for affected customers at 08:22 UTC — should reduce error surface while we triage.

support_li: confirmed error rate dropped ~60% for affected tenants after fallback. still seeing some 5xx.

morgan: quick repro: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -d '{
